title: The Community Survey: What the Numbers Really Say
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟材料，不是官方雅思试题。先读文章，再做题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。语法部分先看中文讲解，再完成8道新题。
passage:
Last month, a group of volunteers in the town of Greenfield carried out a survey about local shopping habits. The group wanted to know how often people shopped in the town centre and what they thought of the local market. They printed 500 questionnaires and gave them out on a Saturday morning outside the main supermarket. By the end of the day, they had collected 320 completed forms.

A. The volunteers were pleased with the number of responses. However, when they began to analyse the data, they noticed several problems. First, most of the people who answered the survey were older residents. Only 18 per cent of the respondents were under 30 years old. The volunteers knew that younger people often shop online, so the survey may not represent the whole town.

B. Second, the questions were not always clear. One question asked, “How often do you visit the town centre?” The possible answers were “every day”, “once a week”, “once a month” and “rarely”. But some people said they visited twice a week, and others said they came only at Christmas. These answers did not fit the categories. As a result, the data for this question was less reliable than the volunteers had hoped.

C. Third, there was a problem with the time of day. The volunteers stood outside the supermarket from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. People who work during the day were not there. There were very few responses from office workers. The group realised that the survey missed a large group of shoppers.

Despite these limitations, the survey produced some useful trends. For example, 65 per cent of respondents said they bought fresh food at the local market at least once a week. This was more than the number who bought fresh food at the supermarket (45 per cent). Also, there were more women than men in the sample: 60 per cent of respondents were women. The volunteers thought this might be because women do more food shopping in this town.

When the group presented their findings, they were careful to explain the limits. They said, “Our survey gives us a picture, but it is not a perfect photograph. We need more responses from younger people and from people who work full-time. Next time, we will use an online survey as well, and we will ask clearer questions.”

The group also compared their results with a similar survey from five years ago. In that survey, only 40 per cent of people said they bought fresh food at the local market once a week. So the new figure (65 per cent) shows an increase. However, the volunteers warned that the two surveys used different methods, so the comparison may not be completely fair.

In the end, the group learned an important lesson: numbers can tell a story, but we must always ask who gave the numbers and how they were collected. A survey is only as good as its questions and its sample.

grammar.title: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 比较结构：用 more/less/fewer + 名词 + than 比较数量，例如 more women than men；用 -er/more + 形容词 + than 比较程度，例如 less reliable than。2) 百分比与数量：用 X per cent of + 名词，谓语动词根据名词单复数决定，例如 65 per cent of respondents said...；分数/百分数作主语时注意主谓一致。3) there was / were：表示“有”，单数用 there was，复数用 there were，例如 There were very few responses. 4) 趋势动词：show an increase, increase, rise, fall, go up, go down 等，描述数据变化。注意：比较结构是本课新学形式；there was/were 是复习内容。
grammar.example: Also, there were more women than men in the sample: 60 per cent of respondents were women.

questions.prompt: There ______ more cars than bicycles in the parking lot yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是复数名词cars，且时间是yesterday，所以用there were。
questions.evidence: There were more cars than bicycles in the parking lot yesterday.

questions.prompt: The new library is ______ than the old one.
questions.explanation: 比较两个图书馆，用比较级bigger，且big是重读闭音节，双写g加-er。
questions.evidence: The new library is bigger than the old one.

questions.prompt: Seventy per cent of the students ______ passed the exam.
questions.explanation: “Seventy per cent of the students”中心词是复数students，谓语用复数have。
questions.evidence: Seventy per cent of the students have passed the exam.

questions.prompt: There ______ a small shop on this street ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 主语a small shop是单数，且时间是ten years ago，所以用there was。
questions.evidence: There was a small shop on this street ten years ago.

questions.prompt: The number of visitors ______ from 200 to 500 last year.
questions.explanation: 描述去年数据变化，用过去式increased。
questions.evidence: The number of visitors increased from 200 to 500 last year.

questions.prompt: This year, there are ______ rainy days than last year.
questions.explanation: rainy days是可数名词复数，比较数量用fewer。
questions.evidence: This year, there are fewer rainy days than last year.

questions.prompt: The price of the ticket is ______ than I expected.
questions.explanation: 比较价格高低，用比较级higher。
questions.evidence: The price of the ticket is higher than I expected.

questions.prompt: Eighty per cent of the water ______ clean.
questions.explanation: water是不可数名词，百分数修饰不可数名词时谓语用单数is。
questions.evidence: Eighty per cent of the water is clean.
